title: croton rigidus
intro: Croton rigidus, commonly known as the "Yellow Balsam", is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits in treating various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Croton rigidus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
